title.zh: 互助基金（互助基金业务限制）条例 1972
title.en: Chit Funds (Limits on Chit Fund Business) Regulations 1972

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Chit Funds (Limits on Chit Fund Business) Regulations 1972.

heading.en: Total value of chit funds at any one time

text.en: 2. The total value of the chit funds to be conducted at any one time by a chit fund company must not exceed 20 times the value of the paid‑up capital of that company.
